This includes, e.g., the provision of Level-2 Forest data (like above ground biomass density) that does not exist currently in the portfolio of Copernicus products. To support this goal, this activity aims to prototype and develop the ROSE-L L2 Forest processor. The activity will be divided in two phases. The first phase is dedicated to the consolidation of algorithms and product performances, definition of the calibration and validation approach and prototyping activities.The second phase is mainly dedicated to the evolution of the prototype into the operational processor, and it also includes the consolidation of Calibration/Validation approach, and support to the potential integration in the ground segment.
